title: Add security section to jmap-push-platform-guide.md
description: The jmap-chat-push-platform-guide.md has a dedicated Security notes section covering push channel encryption and identity trust. jmap-push-platform-guide.md has no equivalent — it mentions E2E encryption in the overview table and scattered prose but lacks a dedicated security section. Add one covering: (1) vendor-visible payloads for non-Web-Push platforms and guidance to omit sensitive content on those channels, (2) credential security (static keys vs OAuth token hygiene), (3) the independence of push-channel encryption from message E2E encryption.
close_reason: Added security section covering vendor-visible payloads, credential security, and E2E independence
